boundedQuestion: What minimum machine-readable quarantine receipt proves that a user-rejected excavator is unreachable from the public/default and future-parent lineage while its failure evidence remains recoverable?

currentProductionObservation.observation: The selected Detailed excavator viewport is blank while its selector and parts list remain visible.
currentProductionObservation.evidentiaryLimit: No public URL, production head, source delta, active import graph, default/fallback registry, desktop capture, exact-head browser receipt or runtime request/draw inventory is bound to the image.

existingMechanisms: REJECTED-DESCENDANT-QUARANTINE-001 covers rejected content reintroduction and publisher reachability.
N217 separates immutable parent identity from scoped parent eligibility.
N251 proves target absence is insufficient while a reachable publisher can recreate the target.
N267 requires source-bound quarantine, negative graph checks and exact-head browser validation.

teacherAudition.clearQuestionAnswer: For the bounded problem of preserving rejected bytes without keeping them active, Nix adds explicit root-and-closure semantics: liveness is reachability from named roots, and the full transitive requisite closure can be queried. KAOPU can therefore model public/default builds and quarantine evidence as separate roots and machine-check that the rejected set is absent from every active closure while present in a quarantine closure.

screening.sourceProvenance: Official NixOS organization repository and nix.dev reference manual.
screening.maintenance: Repository is not archived; latest audited commit is dated 2026-11-10.
screening.runnableCodeTestsData: Official implementation includes computeFSClosure/GC logic and tests/functional/gc.sh with roots, print-live and print-dead assertions.
screening.directRelevance: Rooted transitive reachability separates active deployment liveness from retained evidence.
screening.noveltyOverCurrentBestView: Converts a list of absence checks into an explicit rooted-closure invariant and allows a positive proof of recoverability from a separate quarantine root.
screening.integrationRisks: KAOPU is not a Nix store. JS modules, dynamic network fetches, runtime draw inventories and publishers are not automatically represented as store references and require explicit instrumentation.
screening.demoOnlyOrOpaque: Not demo-only and no training-data dependency; however Nix itself was not installed or executed in this environment.

teacherAudition.registryDecision: Do not add to ACTIVE_TEACHER or method registry before Excavator Mother feedback and one exact production trial.

falsifiableHypothesis.statement: A rejected-lineage quarantine can be considered eligible for independent verification only if the rejected identity set has empty intersection with all active/public/default transitive closures, is fully reachable from a separate quarantine evidence root, is excluded from parent/reference/default registries and final/runtime inventories, and has no reachable publisher capable of recreating the target.
falsifiableHypothesis.falsifier: Any direct or indirect active edge, alias, selector, parent registry entry, final bundle entry, runtime request/draw occurrence, or live matching publisher reaches/recreates a rejected identity; or the rejected evidence is not reachable from the quarantine root.

probe.limitation: Synthetic graph semantics only; not a production, browser, GPU or Nix execution.

decision.nextTrial: Excavator Mother should emit one exact-head receipt from the real production graph and route, then an independent verifier should run the rooted-closure, registry, bundle, runtime and publisher negative checks.
